profiles.purpose: Deterministic unit, schema, codec, and serialization contracts
profiles.notes: Pin Python and TensorFlow from the lock/environment capture; CPU smoke results qualify only for software-contract gates.

profiles.purpose: Large codec sampling, duplicate analysis, and search-space statistics
profiles.notes: No neural model execution is required; persist seeds and every sampled canonical hash or a reproducible aggregate plus collision records.

profiles.purpose: Forward/backward, mixed precision, shape, and serialization validation
profiles.notes: Record accelerator model, driver, CUDA, cuDNN, TensorFlow, precision policy, and batch/input shape.

profiles.purpose: Real graph FLOPs, latency, proxy, and short-training measurements
profiles.notes: Warm up before latency timing, synchronize the device, retain OOMs, and never substitute analytical FLOP estimates for traced graph FLOPs.

profiles.purpose: Peak inference and optimizer-step memory on the declared deployment target
profiles.notes: The exact target device is a preregistered run parameter. Execute one architecture per fresh process; an OOM is data, not a dropped sample.

profiles.purpose: Matched-recipe SR training, multi-seed dry NAS, and CIMEX ablations
profiles.notes: Dataset checksums, crop/degradation pipeline, optimizer, schedule, augmentation, seeds, mixed precision, and wall-clock budget must be frozen before training.

profiles.purpose: Correlation, bootstrap, Pareto, and blinded decision analysis
profiles.notes: Consume immutable upstream result manifests; store scripts, exclusion decisions, confidence intervals, and both raw and multiplicity-adjusted statistics.
